Hi Elena —

Congrats on the product launch last month — impressive uptake. Hightide's usage patterns are exactly the sort of load profile where an upgraded SLA and some regional latency guarantees will materially reduce tail latency risk for your latency-sensitive features.

Per our renewal discussion, I'm proposing a narrow amendment to your existing contract that: 1) adds a Premium Response tier (15 min P1 response + dedicated oncall), 2) introduces regional tail latency SLOs for EU (95th/99th token latency bands), and 3) reserves a modest Dedicated pool (6 GPUs) to smooth burst behavior.

I've attached a short mutual action plan and an SLA annex with the exact latency bands and measurement windows. High-level asks from our side:
- Procurement: sign the amended Addendum and return by 2026-11-10
- Engineering (ops): confirm Dedicated pool sizing is feasible without infra redesign
- Legal: quick redline pass on the annex (we aim for minimal contract churn)

Can you confirm which procurement contact should receive the DocuSign? Also flag anything we missed on your side (regional failover, data residency, or SOC evidence).

Thanks — I’ll schedule a 30m working session if helpful.

Best,

Quick ops note following the working session and the annex review:

• Dedicated pool: 6 GPUs reserved is feasible in eu-west-1. We can provide a +/-2 GPU elasticity window on a quarterly cadence; will document in the SOW.
• Latency SLOs: the 99th token regional tail is implementable using our regional routing + KV prefix caching. The only caveat is long-context batch runs — we will baseline current 99th and 99.9th over the next 72 hours and confirm expected credit exposure.
• Credit mechanics: ops recommends a 30-day rolling window for measuring SLO misses (to avoid transient spikes) with a two-month sustained failure definition for credit triggers; legal can map that into the 60-day credit they requested.

Next steps for us: provide baseline latency report (shared Drive link) and a short SOW paragraph describing elasticity. Rachel — can legal draft the amended credit language to align with procurement's ask?
